description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources contributing to a combined training set, with each segment representing a distinct dataset and its proportional contribution. The largest segment, colored in a medium blue, corresponds to NQ (Natural Questions) at 31.3%, followed by FEVER in teal at 16.1%, and SNLI in brown at 15.4%. MULTINLI, shown in maroon, accounts for 11.3%, while VITAMINC in light teal contributes 13.0%. Smaller segments include ANLI (orange, 4.6%), FACTCC (dark green, 2.6%), ENTFA (yellow-green, 1.8%), SCIFACT (light green, 0.1%), PUBHEALTH (very light green, 0.5%), MULTIFC (dark red, 0.5%), and XSUMHUL (light gray, 1.6%). Each slice is labeled with its dataset name and percentage, connected by thin lines to avoid clutter, and the chart is titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set,” indicating its use in evaluating attribution by large language models as referenced in the associated paper.
